about_the_game:
Explore infinite possibilities with INFINITE LIVES - where superhumans and subhumans fight for control of the ultimate shared universe! Bursting into the 3rd dimension brings new powers with unprecedented freedom, as a combat system perfected by wrestling flies to new heights. An ambitious control system supercharges EVERY button, creating a spectrum of abilities that are easy to enjoy yet difficult to master.

Create your own origin story, as you try to survive in a city dominated by supernatural violence and discover who you really are. Develop powers that make you MORE than human, or lose the spirit that makes you LESS than human - in a vicious cycle that never ends! Find your place among hundreds of other heroes and villains, each trying to rule the world with their own unique powers. Fight over every corner of the map to secure it for your chosen cause, as allegiances change as often as your costume! The city's dozens of locations are filled with hundreds of fully interactive weapons and destructible scenery to add to the action.

Upon discovering every character's secret identity, you can make the world you own by saving your changes in the editor. You can then blow off steam in "Fight Scenes" - where you decide WHO fights WHERE and with WHAT! And when it's time to roam back into the city, you'll have the privilege to start each new life fine-tuned to your liking with more and more options unlocking infinite possibilities:

  • Choose from hundreds of heroes & villains or create your own!

  • Enjoy 2 games for the price of 1 when super-humans become sub-human!

  • Trade blows with a sophisticated combat system inspired by wrestling!

  • Mix & match dozens of different powers attached to EVERY button!

  • Explore a gigantic map that takes you from the city to the stars!

  • Arm yourself with hundreds of fully interactive weapons!

  • Crash into fully interactive furniture & scenery - including animals!

  • Enjoy the action from a wide variety of cinematic camera angles!

  • Express yourself with multiple choice dialogue to write your own story!

  • Fine tune the options to make each new adventure different to the last!
